approvedScope.topology: Tracked Horae route host -> Horae bounded relay -> canonical Ananke -> Horae -> originating Moirae, with R1 application-level request identity and no alternate route.
approvedImplementationShape: Production-style Ananke execution-authentication validation with development mode disabled and ephemeral test authentication supplied out-of-band.
Bounded inspection, readiness, dispatch, and action handling with cancellation and fail-closed cleanup.
Bounded producer-result allowlist projection that prevents unexpected producer fields from overwriting broker-owned fields.
Short-lived, audience-bound, replay-safe application-level request identity with truthful origin semantics.
Reproducible real-process acceptance and additive post-seal qualification of historical 003A.
excluded: Firecracker, KVM, trusted host supervisor, host/guest channel authentication, and all OS/filesystem/network/process/IPC containment.
Live acceptance during this activation/control-state task.

acceptanceCriteria: A tracked Horae server artifact has exact pinned source/build identity.
The route is Moirae -> Horae -> canonical Ananke with no direct, alternate, fallback, or retry path.
Ananke development mode is disabled and ephemeral execution authentication is supplied out-of-band without any credential value in source, logs, or evidence.
Peer inspection/readiness/action handling is bounded and cancellable.
Exactly one dispatch occurs on the positive path and replay-safe application identity rejects malformed, wrong-audience, expired, and replayed requests before dispatch.
Unexpected Ananke result fields cannot cross the Horae projection boundary.
Historical PID correlation is recorded as correlation, never as runtime/OS-authenticated process origin.
The post-seal qualification remains additive and does not rewrite historical 003A evidence or hashes.
